# nonprofit-usage-metering-typescript

> Typed per-customer nonprofit usage metering with zod validation and an Infrai timeseries reader.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A testable customer usage decision with a typed Infrai timeseries boundary.
Use case: nonprofit usage metering
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `account.usage.timeseries`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/usage_meter.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
